info.title: postit API
info.description: Self-hosted social publishing for a small team.

get.summary: Lists the accounts the caller reaches, newest first.
get.description:
# Errors

422 for invalid paging.

post.summary:
Connects the accounts the user picked from a checked credential. The `connect_id` works
once, for the user who checked the credential.
post.description:
# Errors

404 for an unknown, expired, used, or foreign `connect_id`; 409 `platform_disabled` or
`sending_method_exists`.

parameters.name: connect_id
parameters.description: The ID returned by the credential check

post.summary:
Checks pasted credentials against the platform and lists the accounts they reach. The
body is a JSON object with the platform's credential fields. When the credential reaches
accounts, the response carries a one-time `connect_id` to confirm with.
post.description:
# Errors

422 `validation_failed` (every rule the values break, in `violations`) or
`credentials_invalid` (the field at fault, in `field`), 409 `capability_unsupported` for an
OAuth platform, 404 for an unknown platform, 429 when the credential-check limit is spent.

requestBody.description: The credential fields the platform asks for

post.summary:
Imports credential accounts from a CSV file (`Content-Type: text/csv`). The header row
lists the platform's credential fields and may add `display_name`. With `commit=false`
(the default) it only checks every row; with `commit=true` it connects the valid ones. The
report never contains a field value.
post.description:
# Errors

413 past the configured size, 422 for a bad header. A file over the row limit is read up to
the limit and the report says `truncated`.

parameters.name: commit
parameters.description: `true` connects the valid rows; `false` (the default) only checks the file.

get.summary: One account.
get.description:
# Errors

404 for a missing account or one outside a delegate's account limit.

delete.summary:
Disconnects an account: cancels its pending and parked deliveries and keeps the row for
history.
delete.description:
# Errors

409 `job_active` while a post is being published to the account.

patch.summary: Changes the test flag or display name. Last writer wins: accounts carry no version.
patch.description:
# Errors

422 for a blank or over-long name.

post.summary:
Asks the platform whether the account still works. A rejected credential is not an error:
the response shows the account as `needs_reconnect`.
post.description:
# Errors

422 `validation_failed` for a disconnected account; 503 when the platform cannot answer.

get.summary: Lists audit events, newest first, with optional filters.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for invalid filters or paging.

parameters.name: actor_user_id
parameters.description: Only events performed by this user.

get.summary: Lists jobs, newest first, with optional filters.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for invalid filters or paging.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (RFC 3339) on the state's relevant timestamp.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound (RFC 3339) on the state's relevant timestamp.

get.summary: The recurring jobs with their last and next runs.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins.

post.summary: Runs a recurring job now, outside its schedule.
post.description:
With an `Idempotency-Key`, a repeated request (a client or network retry) answers with
the first run's response instead of starting a second run.

# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 404 for a name that is not a recurring job.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for a repeated key instead of starting a second run (24 h)

get.summary: Job counts per state, type and queue, and attempt throughput over a window.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for a window outside 1-168 hours.

get.summary: One job with its attempt history.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 404 for an unknown job.

delete.summary: Deletes a finished job and its attempt history.
delete.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown job and 409 when the job has not finished
(`job_action_not_allowed`).

post.summary: Cancels a queued or scheduled job before it runs.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown job and 409 when the job is not queued
(`job_action_not_allowed`).

post.summary: Re-runs a failed, dead, killed or cancelled job as a new job.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown job and 409 when the job's state or type
does not allow a retry (`job_action_not_allowed`).

get.summary: Public OIDC settings the client needs to start a sign-in.
The caller's own profile. Reachable while the account is still pending approval.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 401 without a valid token, 403 for a disabled account.

delete.summary: Starts deleting the caller's own account.
delete.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 while pending (or for a disabled or already-deleting account, which `Auth`
rejects first), 422 when the display name does not match, 409 for the last active admin.

get.summary: The caller's preferences. Reachable while the account is still pending approval.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 401 without a valid token, 403 for a disabled account.

put.summary: Changes the caller's preferences. Reachable while the account is still pending approval.
put.description:
# Errors

Returns 401 without a valid token, 403 for a disabled account, 422 for an unsupported
locale.

get.summary: Lists the owner's media, newest first.
get.description:
# Errors

422 for invalid paging.

post.summary:
Uploads a whole file in one request. The body is the raw file and `Content-Length` is
required. The stored type is what the bytes sniff as, never the request's `Content-Type`.
With an `Idempotency-Key`, a replay is recognized by the file name, `Content-Length`, and
`Content-Type` (the streamed body is not hashed).
post.description:
# Errors

413 `payload_too_large` (kind limit or single-request limit) or `storage_quota_exceeded`
before any byte is stored, 415 `unsupported_media_type`, 422 `validation_failed` for a bad
name, a missing `Content-Length`, or a body that does not match it.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description:
The file name, 1 to 255 characters. Its extension (`jpg`, `png`, `gif`, `webp`, `mp4`,
`m4v`, `mov`) picks the kind and so the size limit. Metadata only.

post.summary:
Starts a resumable upload. Send the file in chunks with `PUT /media/uploads/{id}`, ask
`HEAD` where it stands, and close it with `POST /media/uploads/{id}/complete`.
post.description:
# Errors

The refusals of the single-request upload that need no body: 413, 415, 422.

put.summary:
Appends a chunk. `Content-Range: bytes {start}-{end}/{total}` is required, `start` must be
the stored offset, and the body must be exactly `end - start + 1` bytes. After a dropped
connection, ask `HEAD` for the offset and resume there: bytes stored past it are cut off.
put.description:
# Errors

409 `upload_offset_mismatch` (see `offset`), 413 over the chunk limit, 422
`validation_failed` (`field: content_range`), 404 for a missing or expired session.

head.summary:
Where an upload stands: `Upload-Offset` (the next byte to send) and `Upload-Length` (the
declared size), with no body.
head.description:
# Errors

404 for a missing or expired session.

Upload-Offset.description: Bytes stored; the next chunk starts here

post.summary:
Closes an upload whose last byte arrived: checks the bytes, reads their size, and makes the
thumbnail. A file that is not an accepted image or video of the kind its name claims fails
the upload and removes it.
post.description:
# Errors

409 `upload_offset_mismatch` (see `offset`) before the last byte, 415
`unsupported_media_type`, 404 for a missing or expired session.

get.summary: Storage used against the quota.
get.description:
# Errors

403 without `view` access.

get.summary: One asset.
get.description:
# Errors

404 for a missing asset.

delete.summary: Deletes an asset and its files.
delete.description:
# Errors

409 `media_in_use` while a post or an unfinished job uses it.

get.summary:
The file, with `Range` and conditional-request support. The type is what the bytes sniffed
as; the response is sandboxed and never sniffed.
get.description:
# Errors

404 for a missing or unfinished asset, 416 for a range past the end.

416.description: The range is past the end of the file

get.summary: The JPEG thumbnail, longest side 480 px.
get.description:
# Errors

404 for a missing asset or one without a thumbnail.

416.description: The range is past the end of the file

get.summary: Short-lived signed URLs for showing the asset without a bearer token, for example in an `` tag.
get.description:
# Errors

404 for a missing or unfinished asset.

get.summary: Lists users, filtered by status, role, and a name/email search, ordered by `sort`.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 422 for invalid filters or paging.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of display name or email.

get.summary: One user by id.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins and 404 for an unknown id.

delete.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins or self-deletion, 404 for an unknown id, 409 for the last
admin or a user already being deleted.

patch.summary: Changes one user's status or role (exactly one field per request).
patch.description:
# Errors

Returns 403 for non-admins, 404 for an unknown id, 409 for a user being deleted or the
last admin, and 422 for a malformed or disallowed change.

get.summary: Liveness probe: answers while the process is running.

The file behind a signed URL from `GET /media/{id}/view-url`, with no bearer token. The
signature covers the asset and the expiry; anything wrong with it, or no signature at all,
is `403 forbidden`, with the same answer whether or not the asset exists.
get.description:
# Errors

403 `forbidden` for a bad, missing, or expired signature; 404 when the asset is gone.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Unix time the URL stops working.

416.description: The range is past the end of the file

get.summary:
The JPEG thumbnail behind a signed URL. It needs its own signature: the content URL's does
not work here.
get.description:
# Errors

403 `forbidden` for a bad, missing, or expired signature; 404 when the asset is gone or has
no thumbnail.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Unix time the URL stops working.

416.description: The range is past the end of the file

get.summary: # Errors
get.description: Returns a 503 problem naming the first failing readiness check.

status.description: Whether the account can be used.

Every audit event kind (`AuditEventKind` in `postit-data`); the `OpenAPI` enum the web

account_ids.description: The `remote_id` of each account to connect; omit to connect every discovered account.

ConfirmResponse.description: The result of confirming a connection.

DeleteMeRequest.description: Confirmation for deleting one's own account.

display_name.description: Must equal the caller's current display name.

cancelled_deliveries.description: Pending and parked deliveries that were cancelled.

native_scheduled_remaining.description: Deliveries still held for a later time on the platform's side.

DiscoveredAccountDto.description: An account a pasted credential reaches.

remote_id.description: The platform's ID for the account. Pass it to confirm to pick this account.

counts.description: How many rows ended each way, keyed by status.

ImportRowDto.description: The report line for one data row. Never carries a field value.

account_ids.description: The accounts created or matched; empty on a dry run.

display_name_ignored.description: A `display_name` was given but the row reaches more than one account.

field.description: The credential field at fault, when known.

JobActionResponse.description: The job a retry or trigger created.

JobActionsDto.description: The console actions the job currently offers.

cancel.description: Cancel the job before it runs.

delete.description: Delete the job and its history.

retry.description: Re-run the job as a new job.

JobCountDto.description: A count under a key (state, type or queue).

run_at.description: When the job is (or was) due.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

window_hours.description: Length of the throughput window in hours.

LocaleDto.description: A language the interface and emails can be shown in.

account_url.description: The identity provider's account page (`auth.oidc.account_url`), when configured.

mime.description: The MIME type the bytes sniffed as; unset until the upload completes.

original_filename.description: The name the uploaded file had. Metadata only; it never reaches a path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes, once known.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

used_bytes.description: Bytes stored or reserved by open uploads.

oneOf.description: How it is connected; absent when this build has no agent for the platform.

last_checked_at.description: When the connection was last verified.

status.description: Whether the account can be used.

details.description: Event details. Every `*_user_id` value is a `UserRef` object.

ip.description: Client IP, until it is cleared by retention.

request_id.description: `X-Request-Id` of the request that caused the event.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

actions_disabled_reason.description: Why no action applies, when none does.

finished_at.description: When the job reached a final state.

recurring_name.description: Name of the recurring schedule that enqueued it.

run_at.description: When the job is (or was) due.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

mime.description: The MIME type the bytes sniffed as; unset until the upload completes.

original_filename.description: The name the uploaded file had. Metadata only; it never reaches a path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes, once known.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

items.description: A postit user as admins and the user themselves see it. Profile fields come from the identity provider.

approved_at.description: When an admin approved the user.

approved_by.description: The admin who approved the user.

email.description: Email address from the identity provider, when it supplied one.

email_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the email address.

last_seen_at.description: When the user last made an authenticated request.

updated_at.description: When the user was last changed.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

locale.description: The language of the interface and of emails sent to the caller.

ProblemDetails.description: The RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body every error response carries.

field.description: `credentials_invalid`: the credential field at fault, when known.

missing_scopes.description: `credentials_invalid`: scopes the credentials lack, when the platform says.

request_id.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the failed request, for support.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

violations.description: `validation_failed` on account routes: every rule the input broke, by field.

RecurringJobDto.description: A recurring job and its schedule.

next_run_at.description: When the next run is due.

ThroughputBucketDto.description: Attempt outcomes within one time bucket.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Settings the owner may change on an account.

test_account.description: Mark or unmark the account as a test account.

locale.description: `en-US` or `ar`; anything else is rejected with `validation_failed`.

UploadOffsetDto.description: Where an upload stands after a chunk.

offset.description: Bytes stored so far; the next chunk starts here.

expires_at.description: When the session expires if left open.

id.description: The asset ID the upload becomes.

filename.description:
The file name, 1 to 255 characters. Its extension (`jpg`, `png`, `gif`, `webp`, `mp4`,
`m4v`, `mov`) picks the kind and so the size limit.

size.description: The whole file's size in bytes.

UserDto.description: A postit user as admins and the user themselves see it. Profile fields come from the identity provider.

approved_at.description: When an admin approved the user.

approved_by.description: The admin who approved the user.

email.description: Email address from the identity provider, when it supplied one.

email_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the email address.

last_seen_at.description: When the user last made an authenticated request.

updated_at.description: When the user was last changed.

UserRef.description:
A user reference in the audit log. `deleted` is true for a pseudonym left by user
deletion (a UUID v8, which postit never generates otherwise). `display_name` is the
user's current name, or null for a pseudonym or a user no longer present.

deleted.description: Whether the user has been deleted.

display_name.description: The user's current name, when known.

id.description: User ID, or the pseudonym that replaced it.

thumbnail_url.description: Its thumbnail, when it has one.
